subject: Charged twice for the October invoice
body: Our card was charged twice on October 3 for the same invoice, INV-20931. Both charges show on the statement and the receipt went to billing@bluefin.example. Please refund the duplicate and confirm it will not happen on the next cycle.

subject: Invoice still shows the old seat count
body: We reduced from 260 to 240 seats in September through the admin console, but the October invoice bills 260 seats. Can you correct the invoice and credit the difference?

subject: Need tax form and updated address on invoices
body: Our accounts payable team needs your current tax form on file before they can release payment, and invoices should show our new headquarters address. No urgency, the invoice is not due until next month.

subject: Refund request after an accidental annual upgrade
body: I clicked upgrade by mistake while comparing plans and was charged $348 for a year of Pro. We are a two person shop and only wanted the free tier. The card used was 4111 1111 1111 1111 if you need it to find the charge. Please refund.

subject: Payment failed, service suspends in two days
body: The dashboard says our payment failed and the account suspends in 48 hours. We already updated the card but the retry button does nothing. 35 people depend on this. Call our office at 555-201-7788 if you need anything from us.

subject: Sales tax charged although we are tax exempt
body: We uploaded our tax exemption certificate in June, but the last two invoices still include sales tax. Please remove the tax going forward and credit the amounts already charged.

subject: Proration on mid-cycle downgrade looks wrong
body: We moved two seats from Pro to the basic tier on the 12th. The credit on the invoice is about half of what I expected. Could someone walk me through how the proration was calculated?

subject: Receipts going to an inbox nobody checks
body: Receipts and invoices still go to ops-old@fernhill.example, which is no longer monitored. Please send them to accounts@fernhill.example instead. Nothing is overdue, we just want the paperwork in the right place.

subject: Two-factor codes not arriving by SMS
body: Since yesterday afternoon nobody on our team receives the SMS verification code. People using the authenticator app can still log in, but about twenty staff rely on SMS and are locked out. The number on file for our admin is +1 (555) 310-0199.

subject: Locked out, password reset link says expired
body: I requested a password reset three times. Every link says it has expired the moment I open it, even within a minute of the email arriving. I cannot get into my account at all.

subject: SSO login fails for everyone with a SAML error
body: Since 08:00 this morning every one of our 900 users gets an 'invalid SAML response' error at login. Our identity team rotated the signing certificate on our identity provider last night. Nobody can get in and claims processing has stopped.

subject: Cannot remove a departed admin from the account
body: One of our administrators left the company. When I try to remove the account the button is greyed out. The person no longer has access to company email so there is no security issue, but we want the seat freed up.

subject: Revoked API key still works
body: We revoked a production API key about an hour ago because it was committed to a public repository. Requests using that key are still succeeding. We need it to stop accepting requests immediately.

subject: Email change confirmation never arrives
body: I am trying to change the login email for our account to orders@orchardstreet.example. The confirmation email never shows up, not even in spam. I have tried four times over two days.

subject: Login alert from a country where none of us are
body: We got a notification about a successful login to our workspace from a country where we have no staff. Nothing looks changed yet. We want to force logout every session and make sure the account is secure.

subject: Recovery codes do not work after losing my phone
body: My phone was stolen and I cannot get two-factor codes anymore. I kept the printed recovery codes but every one of them is rejected as invalid. I am the only admin on our account.

subject: Dashboard returning 502 for all users
body: Every page of the dashboard returns a 502 error for all of our users across two offices. This started about fifteen minutes ago. Our editorial deadline is in three hours and nobody can work.

subject: Webhooks delayed by more than forty minutes
body: Shipment status webhooks are arriving 40 to 50 minutes late. Our warehouse screens are showing stale data and drivers are waiting. Deliveries themselves work, but the delay is causing confusion on the floor.

subject: Exports stuck in processing since last night
body: Three CSV exports we started last night are still showing as processing this morning. Smaller exports work. We need the data for a client review tomorrow.

subject: Scheduled reports did not send this morning
body: Our daily 7am appointment summary report did not arrive today. The schedule still shows as active in the settings. Yesterday's report came through fine.

subject: Intermittent timeouts on the search endpoint
body: About five percent of our calls to the search API are timing out after 30 seconds since Monday. Retries usually succeed. It is not blocking us but our customers see spinners.

subject: Mobile app shows a blank screen after the update
body: After updating the mobile app yesterday it opens to a blank white screen. The website works fine for us, so we can keep going, but the tutors prefer the app on the go.

subject: Everything is slow for us in the EU, pages take 20 seconds
body: Since about 10:00 CET every page takes 15 to 20 seconds to load for all nine of us. Our colleagues at a partner practice in the US say it is fine for them. We are running a clinic and checking patients in is painfully slow.

subject: Status page says operational but the API is down for us
body: Our integration has been failing since 06:10 UTC with connection resets on every call. Your status page is all green. We have checked our own network and other APIs work. Inbound freight scheduling is stopped across 240 users.

subject: Request: dark mode for the dashboard
body: I work late and the white dashboard is hard on the eyes. A dark theme would be great. Not urgent at all, just a wish.

subject: Export to Parquet in addition to CSV
body: Our analytics pipeline ingests Parquet. Converting your CSV exports is an extra step that occasionally breaks on quoting. Native Parquet export would save us real time each week.

subject: Need granular per-project permissions
body: We are rolling out to two more departments but cannot because every user currently sees every project. We need project level roles. This is blocking a contracted rollout at the end of the quarter.

subject: Please support SCIM provisioning
body: We manage 240 seats by hand today. SCIM provisioning from our identity provider would remove a weekly manual process and the security risk of forgotten deprovisioning. Is there a beta we can join?

subject: Keyboard shortcuts for navigating tickets
body: It would be nice to move between tickets with j and k and close with a shortcut like other tools. Small thing, but it adds up over a day.

subject: Webhook retry configuration
body: When our endpoint is briefly down we lose webhooks because there is only one retry. We would like to configure the retry count and backoff. Right now we poll as a workaround.

subject: Can we get a Slack integration?
body: Our volunteer team lives in Slack. Posting new ticket notifications into a channel would help us respond faster. Is this planned?

subject: Audit log retention beyond 90 days
body: Our compliance team requires one year of audit logs. The current 90 day window means we export monthly by hand. Is longer retention available or planned?

subject: Someone is impersonating our company on your platform
body: A workspace on your platform is using our company name and logo and has been contacting our customers asking them to update payment details. Two customers forwarded the messages to us. Please take it down and tell us what you need from us.

subject: Spam flooding our shared inbox form
body: We get about fifty junk submissions a day through the public inbox form, mostly advertising. Real customer messages are getting buried. Is there a spam filter or rate limit we can turn on?

subject: Harassing messages from another member in shared channels
body: One member of a shared channel keeps sending threatening and demeaning messages to one of our tutors, including after being asked to stop. We have screenshots. We need the account dealt with and the messages removed.

subject: Phishing page hosted on one of your public share links
body: Our customers are receiving emails pointing to a public share link on your domain that hosts a fake login page styled like ours. At least one customer entered their password. Please disable the link immediately.

subject: Scraper hammering our public form
body: Something is submitting thousands of entries per hour to our public feedback form from rotating IP addresses. The form still works but the data is garbage and our quota is being eaten. Can you block this traffic?

subject: Report: a workspace is distributing pirated content
body: I came across a public workspace on your platform sharing full copies of paid design assets, including some of ours. I am not sure whether this is the right place to report it or whether it needs a formal notice.

subject: Threatening message that mentions our office address
body: A message came through the patient contact form that threatens our front desk staff and includes our street address and opening hours. Staff are frightened. We have reported it to the police and need you to preserve the sender details.

subject: Fake reviews about our clinic in the community area
body: Several reviews appeared in your community section over the weekend describing visits that never happened at our clinic. They all come from accounts created on the same day. Can they be reviewed and removed?
